label: mashite ~ hazuganai
title_raw: まして〜はずがない [まして〜はずがない] (mashite ~ hazuganai)
title: まして〜はずがない
meaning: it is even more unlikely that 〜
meaning_example: even adults also being eluded of this matter,there is no way/it is even more unlikely that children knows such a thing

examples.japanese: 大人でさえ知らない事は、 まして子供は知っているはずがない。
examples.body_text:
大人でさえ知らない事は、 まして子供は知っているはずがない。 

It is even more unlikely/it is impossible 
		for children to know things that even adults don't know.
examples.body_html:
大人でさえ知らない事は、 まして子供は知っているはずがない。 
It is even more unlikely/it is impossible for children to know things that even adults don't know.

examples.japanese: 大人でさえ知らないし、まして子供は知っているはずがない。
examples.body_text:
大人でさえ知らないし、まして子供は知っているはずがない。 

		Even adutls also have no idea about it, 
		it is even more unlikely for/it is impossible for/let alone of 
		children to know about it.
examples.body_html:
大人でさえ知らないし、まして子供は知っているはずがない。 
Even adutls also have no idea about it, it is even more unlikely for/it is impossible for/let alone of children to know about it.

comments.text: In #, 大人でさえ知らない事は should be changed to read: 大人でさえ知らないし
comments.html: In #, 大人でさえ知らない事は should be changed to read: 大人でさえ知らないし

comments.text: The English is wonky.  How about "It is impossible for children to know about this matter that even adults don't know."?  For bamboo4's suggestion: "Even adults don't know about this thing, so it's impossible that children would know it."
comments.html: The English is wonky.  How about "It is impossible for children to know about this matter that even adults don't know."?  For bamboo4's suggestion: "Even adults don't know about this thing, so it's impossible that children would know it."
